QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_87

question.text: When clients opt for additional facilities (such as power of attorney) after initially opening through SARAL AOF, they must:

answer.text: Furnish additional information as per prescribed regulations/circulars
Close the existing account and open a new one
Wait for one year after initial account opening

explanation.text: The Logic: SARAL AOF investors may later obtain other facilities such as internet trading, margin trading, derivative trading, and use of power of attorney by furnishing additional information as per prescribed regulations and circulars. The existing account is not required to be closed. The Trap: SARAL AOF is an entry point for first-time investors, not a permanent limitation; subsequent facility upgrades are allowed on additional disclosures. Note: Upgrades layer on top of the existing SARAL AOF account.
